description_en: Queries the list of HTTP 301 status code redirects for a website
kebab_example: aliyun websitebuild list-app-domain-redirect-records --biz-id WD20250703155602000001 --max-results 1 --next-token yPkgBbQln0gmUnIZSGizGw== --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAppDomainRedirectRecords

parameters.help_en: The business ID of the application instance
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query. This parameter is empty if no more results exist
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token。没有下一个查询时为空
parameters.name: next_token
